texts.game: Your original Xbox disc of Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne (NTSC-U) as an .iso, or the folder it was extracted to (with default.xbe and DATA.RAS).
texts.settings: The port writes its settings file, MPayne2-nx.toml, at its first start; this package carries the default one.
texts.footer: Max Payne is a trademark of its owners. This is an unofficial fan port; not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's publishers, Microsoft or Nintendo.
texts.nro: Your own build of the port, MPayne2-nx.nro, made from the source at github.com/maafeu/MPayne2-nx (the deko3d build: -DPORT_RENDERER=dk). This page does not include it: it holds the game's recompiled code, which only your own copy of the game should make.
texts.launch: Start it from hbmenu while holding R on an installed game (title mode: the game needs all the console's memory). The console settings that hold 60 fps everywhere, an optional Horizon-OC profile, are in TESTING.md.
